question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
        MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
        AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
    FROM Track
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT 
        (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as short_medium_threshold,
        (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as medium_long_threshold
    FROM track_stats
),
classified_tracks AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= t2.short_medium_threshold THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= t2.medium_long_threshold THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END as category
    FROM Track t, thresholds t2
),
track_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.category as cat,
        il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity as line_revenue
    FROM classified_tracks ct
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON ct.TrackId = il.TrackId
)
SELECT 
    ct.category,
    MIN(ct.duration_minutes) as min_duration_minutes,
    MAX(ct.duration_minutes) as max_duration_minutes,
    SUM(tr.line_revenue) as total_revenue
FROM classified_tracks ct
JOIN track_revenue tr ON ct.category = tr.cat
GROUP BY ct.category
ORDER BY ct.category

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
        MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
        AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
    FROM Track
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT 
        min_ms,
        max_ms,
        avg_ms,
        (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as mid1,
        (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as mid2
    FROM stats
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.Name,
        t.Milliseconds,
        t.UnitPrice,
        th.min_ms,
        th.max_ms,
        th.mid1,
        th.mid2,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= th.mid1 THEN 'short'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= th.mid2 THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'long'
        END as duration_category
    FROM Track t
    CROSS JOIN thresholds th
)
SELECT 
    duration_category,
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) as total_revenue
FROM classified
GROUP BY duration_category
